author: Hermes
question: Which of these topics is listed under Section 2 (Electric circuits) of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus?
solution: Section 2 of the official EE syllabus covers network elements, KCL/KVL, network theorems, transients, sinusoidal steady state, resonance, two-port networks, three-phase circuits and related topics; hydraulic turbines, organic chemistry and macroeconomics belong to other papers. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Syllabus
